Subject: Clarification of the Bi-weekly Financial Report Process

Dear Team,

I hope this message finds you well.

To ensure we are all on the same page and to streamline the process, I would like to provide some clarification regarding the bi-weekly financial report. The report is to be prepared by the financial analyst and submitted to the finance manager for review and approval by the end of each Thursday. After approval, the finance manager will distribute the report to the relevant department heads for their review and subsequent feedback, which should be provided by the following Monday.

Please note that any discrepancies or questions should be raised by the department heads during this feedback period, so they can be addressed before the report is finalized and circulated to the wider team.

If you have any questions or need further explanation on any aspect of this process, I encourage you to reach out to me directly. Your input
